messages.content:
【题目】
Let A=\left[\begin{array}{cccc}-16 &-9 &20 &-12\cr-4 &3 &5 &4\cr 0 &6 &0 &8 \end{array}\right]. Find a non-zero vector in the column space of $A$.
\begin {array}{c} [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \end{array}

In the section 可核对结论, the line starting with 结论 must contain only the [ANS] values in order, separated by ' | '. Do not add words on that line.

【已有解法类型】
线性空间解法

【必须给出】
矩阵解法

【翻译规则】
这是翻译，不是重新选题。沿用已有解法里合法的不唯一选择，不要改成你自己更习惯的取法。
若其中有计算错误，可核对结论写改正后的结果；约定仍沿用说得通的原取法，并在检验中指出错误。

【已有解法】
Linear-space solution.
Let T: R^4 -> R^3 be T(x)=Ax. The column space of A is the image of T.
The first standard basis vector e1 satisfies T(e1)=Ae1, which is the first column of A. That image is (-16,-9,20), which is not zero, so it is a nonzero vector of im(T).
Convention locked by this solution: use the image of e1, not the image of another basis vector.
Checkable values: -16, -9, 20.
